root.label: NSF announces 12 Regional Innovation Engines awards

events.label: NSF announces 12 Regional Innovation Engines awards

slots.name: new awards
slots.sentence: Last week, the National Science Foundation (NSF) announced 12 new Regional Innovation Engines awards, which could bring up $160 million to each of the selected coalitions over the next 10 years.

slots.name: supported regions
slots.sentence: This announcement comes after NSF extended awards to eight inaugural Engines this past May, and brings the program’s total number of supported regions to 20—representing over $3 billion in potential funding over 10 years.
